input_draft: There's unsent text in the input box on the computer
dialog_open: A dialog is open on the computer. Deal with it, then send
dialog_open_named: A dialog is open on the computer: “{dialog}”. Deal with it, then send
delivery_unknown: Not sure it arrived. Check the chat before sending again
not_confirmed: Not confirmed before the page closed. Retry won't send it twice
not_confirmed_images: Not confirmed before the page closed, and its pictures weren't kept
waits_on_computer: Sent. The Agent will read it after the question on the computer is answered
held_on_computer: Waiting for approval on the computer. This Claude session runs in bypass permissions mode, so it holds Persona's messages until you allow them there. Once allowed, it shows here by itself
peer_unconfirmed: Handed to this Claude session, but it hasn't taken it yet. It may be waiting for approval on the computer. Look there before sending it again
peer_unconfirmed_old_plugin: This Claude session hasn't taken it. It runs an older Persona plugin, so while it works your message goes through its message inbox, which can drop it. Look on the computer before sending again. Reopen the session there once and your messages will go in as your own input
still_held: Still waiting for approval on the computer
still_unknown: Not in the chat yet. Look on the computer before sending it again
relayed_busy: Sent through the Agent's message inbox while it was busy: it may not take this as your approval. If it needs your go-ahead, send it again once the Agent is waiting for you
relayed_plugin: Sent through the Agent's message inbox, not as your own input: it may not take this as your approval
relayed_old_plugin: Sent through the session's message inbox: it runs an older Persona plugin, so while it works your message can't go in as your own input, and it may not take it as your approval. Reopen the session on the computer once to fix this
